title: We love our monthly Jerky Snob!
text: I originally purchased this subscription for my husband as a gift but it has become a gift for both of us. We both love jerky and it's fun to get the new flavors each month. We try them together and both rate our faves. We have done six months so far and have not had any that we didn't like at all. Of course, some you like more than others but it's fun to try new jerky. We recommend this for a gift or just for yourself if you love jerky!
label: positive
